Boocord Music Discord 5.0.1 increases the playlist request limit to 10,000 songs.

Changes:

- Playlist browsing and search request up to 10,000 songs from the API.
- `/play` matching, shuffle, and automatic shuffle refills use the increased catalog limit.
- Favorites retain a separate limit of 1,000 distinct song IDs per command to bound individual API requests.

The API may enforce its own limits. Playback-session restoration still retains only the first 100 upcoming songs.

No configuration changes or additional database migrations are required for this update. Follow the [owner update guide](https://github.com/BoocordStudios/BoocordMusicDiscord/blob/v5.0.1/docs/OWNER_UPDATE_GUIDE.md) to replace the JAR and restart the bot.

The attached JAR targets Linux x86-64 with glibc and requires Java 17 or newer. Use the accompanying `.sha256` file to verify the download. Other supported platforms can be built from source as documented in the README.
